steps.text: Every pin has a physical number (1-40) and a name. Pin 20 is called GP15, which means GPIO number 15. In your code you use the GPIO number: Pin(15), not 20.
Find GP16 on the labels and click it.

expect.hint: GP16 is physical pin 21, at the bottom of the right side.
expect.success: Right: GP16 is pin 21. In code it is Pin(16).

steps.text: Not every pin is a GPIO. Black labels are GND (ground, the − side). Red labels are power, like 3V3 (3.3 V). Click any GND pin.

expect.hint: Look for the black labels. There are eight GND pins.
expect.success: Yes! All GND pins are connected inside the Pico, so you can use any of them.
